cross_session.audit_head_exclusion_reason: Native audit entries include timestamps; cumulative head hashes therefore change between process sessions. All other saved state, counts, verification booleans, decisions, findings and receipts remain in the exact comparison.

decisions: Use local receipt outcomes as inert enqueue observations; do not infer remote execution or exploit success.
Exclude response and name-context source projections from native-applicability denominator; keep annotation contradiction authored-context caveat.
Preserve separate source/challenge and unique/repeated denominators.
Compare semantic outcomes across sessions, excluding timing and timestamp-derived audit heads.
uncertainty: Hashes bind these local saved files; they are not independent third-party attestation.
Two local process sessions do not establish production overhead or population-level reliability.
coverage_gaps: No model-selection behavior, actual MCP server execution, runtime-response protection, or live exploit success was tested.
Source labels and authored controls express fixture intent; author knowledge is disclosed and no blind holdout exists.
The sanitation scan checks exact source strings and snippets, not all possible paraphrases or encoded copies.
Full reconstructed native audit chains are not exported; audit verification flags are observations from runner records.
